text_block_list.text:
Air Groove hadn't shown up even though it 
was time for training, so while searching 
the campus for her...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Right, now try applying that formula 
from earlier.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
"That formula from earlier... Ah!? I did 
it!"

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Honestly, stumbling over something like 
this... Put a little more effort into your 
studies.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
However, at this rate, you should have no 
problem with tomorrow's test. Good luck.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
choice_data_list: You take good care of others, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Y-You bastard... Why are you here—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Today was training, wasn't it? Ugh, 
I slipped up...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
In any case, I'm sorry. It was entirely my 
fault. I'll be more careful from now on...
